items.title: Dothan spending $89,000 to rename Leisure Services, city rebrand - WTVY
items.raw_summary: Dothan city commissioners voted to rename Dothan Leisure Services to Dothan Parks and Recreation, part of an $89,000 rebranding contract with Slate Communications.
items.title_pt: Dothan gasta $89 mil para renomear Serviços de Lazer e reposicionar a cidade
items.summary_pt: Cidade investe em rebranding completo ao renomear departamento e contratar agência estratégica.
items.pme_pt: Mostra que reposicionamento exige investimento profissional real — mesmo cidades pequenas contratam agências para transformar percepção no mercado.

items.summary_pt: Louis Vuitton vence batalha judicial mas sofre boicote, revelando risco reputacional de decisões de marca sem considerar percepção de mercado.

items.title: In the agentic era of marketing, MarTech partners must have skin in the game: Rajesh Jain, Netcore.ai - ET BrandEquity
items.raw_summary: Netcore.ai, the rebranded successor of Netcore Cloud, shifts to an agentic marketing platform emphasizing outcome-based pricing. Rajesh Jain discusses the need for MarTech to focus on customer retention and redefining vendor relationships in the marketing technology landscape.
